aad1cb8ed8c964a61a9c66a0820b3e1514cde917.text: 与此同时江琴分散了江枫的哥哥燕大侠的注意力。

aad3b4d0bc67e8c31630a62e85cc29974ca2cb78.pinyin: Bō li píng lǐ zhuāng zhe chún jìng de shuǐ.
aad3b4d0bc67e8c31630a62e85cc29974ca2cb78.text: 玻璃瓶里装着纯净的水。

aad64b2224f8cb149ea5f515ce16ceb3cd4e1636.pinyin: gōng rén men zǎo shang qī diǎn kāi gōng.

aad68e008ccc77f8ad9bc4fcadb7b30c4dbbeb45.pinyin: tā zài xiāng xià guò de shí fēn xiāo yáo.
aad68e008ccc77f8ad9bc4fcadb7b30c4dbbeb45.text: 他在乡下过得十分逍遥。

aad6928259dfde08a109173341e0bf8859ce6d16.pinyin: tā zuò xià lái dàn shí miàn bāo.

aad7444a89bc0922715434faab06b41ce74b004e.pinyin: shǒu cái nú jī jù qián cái bù shì yīn wèi tā jǐn shèn, ér shì yīn wèi tā tān lán.
aad7444a89bc0922715434faab06b41ce74b004e.text: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。

aade1b07074aa6c806218d01c27d1cc9f9e18fc8.pinyin: wǒ men fēn sàn kāi lái bìng zài shù lín zhōng zhǎn kāi sōu suǒ.
aade1b07074aa6c806218d01c27d1cc9f9e18fc8.text: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。

aae1a330afca3a05bf985cc78f8a066491df2309.pinyin: zhè tiáo lù chuān guò yí piàn qiū líng.

aae33e5382e68bfdd26258b50dd9d5c0ea480fd4.pinyin: jiē shù yǔ huái shù zài yuán zhōng bìng pái shēng zhǎng.
aae33e5382e68bfdd26258b50dd9d5c0ea480fd4.text: 楷树与槐树在园中并排生长。

aae6be9bc6450ad7cd6241ed680d3ade4128d141.pinyin: shǐ shū jì zǎi le yì bìng duì dāng dì de yǐng xiǎng.
aae6be9bc6450ad7cd6241ed680d3ade4128d141.text: 史书记载了疫病对当地的影响。

aae85233330fbfa9cfcab041a035e48615ff4d2d.pinyin: lǎo shī yāo qiú wǒ men rèn zhēn tīng jiǎng.
aae85233330fbfa9cfcab041a035e48615ff4d2d.text: 老师要求我们认真听讲。

aaeb9bfcc92d59a0bebccd0e3a0f03ea1c3a6d74.pinyin: shī zhōng miáo xiě le jī zhì ér zhōng de rén.
aaeb9bfcc92d59a0bebccd0e3a0f03ea1c3a6d74.text: 诗中描写了赍志而终的人。

aaed78d49f73690848ef0f9555aa37b62efe5fce.pinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me xué xí fāng fǎ?

aaf0878742792d1c7bfcad75a48720767dc270f6.pinyin: tā yīn wèi dān xīn fā pàng ér jié shí.
aaf0878742792d1c7bfcad75a48720767dc270f6.text: 她因为担心发胖而节食。

aaf382f5cb885c5c1557ebfb837df34e96c2880a.pinyin: xiǎo chuán tíng zài shuǐ wēi, bì kāi jí liú.
aaf382f5cb885c5c1557ebfb837df34e96c2880a.text: 小船停在水隈，避开急流。

aaf3c67eab9aedf57362fcf97b1f6823d9f64f68.pinyin: shī yè zhī hòu, tā tǐ huì dào le shì tài yán liáng.
aaf3c67eab9aedf57362fcf97b1f6823d9f64f68.text: 失业之后，他体会到了世态炎凉。

aaf79f29a8bd48a5788732fe72a08bba2ea8c2ce.pinyin: tā wǎng jiǎo zi xiàn lǐ jiā le huí xiāng.
aaf79f29a8bd48a5788732fe72a08bba2ea8c2ce.text: 她往饺子馅里加了茴香。

aaf89e782a3f764817ddb4a479e107c99308b60c.pinyin: zhè jiàn dà yī chuān qǐ lai hěn nuǎn huo.
aaf89e782a3f764817ddb4a479e107c99308b60c.text: 这件大衣穿起来很暖和。

aafac10c93893eb77d20419ed91836bfcf2d34d6.pinyin: tā zài chái bèi zhōng pǒ yǒu míng wàng.

aafc5b2163cf05251cb192e2ecfb1e4f92b850c8.pinyin: chī fàn de shí hou bié kàn shǒu jī.
